title: The Man Who Sold Noodles at 40 Cents for 15 Years | China, Explained
description:
In a village in Feixian County, Shandong, a farmer named Cheng Yunfu sold a bowl of hand-pulled noodles for three yuan — about forty cents — and kept that price for roughly fifteen years. He wouldn't raise it because, he said, his neighbors couldn't afford more. In early 2021 a passing vlogger's video made him an overnight internet celebrity; crowds and livestreamers swarmed his stall, and a few even pretended to be his relatives. He used the attention to help a father publicize the search for his abducted son — who was later found. The noodles? Still three yuan.

This is "China, Explained in 40 Seconds" — one true story, plainly told.

—

Facts verified 2026-11-23:
• Cheng Yunfu, a farmer in Feixian County, Linyi, Shandong, sold hand-pulled noodles for 3 yuan (about 40–46 US cents) for around 15 years, refusing to raise the price so villagers could still afford it; a vlogger's short videos made him viral in early 2021 — The Star, "'Ramen brother' farmer in China selling cheap noodles becomes Internet celebrity" https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2021/03/11/ramen-brother-farmer-in-china-selling-rm190-noodles-becomes-internet-celebrity + Sixth Tone, "The Man Who Accidentally Became a Short-Video Megastar" https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1007202
• The fame overwhelmed him — he hid at a relative's home to sleep — and he used the attention to help father Guo Gangtang spread word of his abducted son, who was reunited with the family in 2021 — Sixth Tone, "How Viral Fame Strained a Noodle Seller Almost to Breaking Point" https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1018467 + Caixin Global, "Noodle Notoriety" https://www.caixinglobal.com/2021-03-10/gallery-noodle-notoriety-101673488.html

es.title: El hombre que vendió fideos a 40 centavos durante 15 años | China, Explicada
es.description: En una aldea de Shandong, el granjero Cheng Yunfu vendía un tazón de fideos tirados a mano por tres yuanes (unos 40 centavos) y mantuvo ese precio unos 15 años: no lo subía porque sus vecinos no podrían pagarlo. En 2021 un video lo hizo famoso de la noche a la mañana. Usó la fama para ayudar a un padre a buscar a su hijo secuestrado, que fue hallado. ¿Los fideos? Siguen a tres yuanes.

pt.title: O homem que vendeu macarrão a 40 centavos por 15 anos | China, Explicada
pt.description: Numa aldeia de Shandong, o agricultor Cheng Yunfu vendia uma tigela de macarrão puxado à mão por três yuans (cerca de 40 centavos) e manteve esse preço por uns 15 anos — não aumentava porque os vizinhos não poderiam pagar. Em 2021 um vídeo o tornou famoso da noite para o dia. Usou a fama para ajudar um pai a procurar o filho sequestrado, que foi encontrado. O macarrão? Ainda três yuans.

id.title: Pria yang Menjual Mi 40 Sen Selama 15 Tahun | China, Dijelaskan
id.description: Di sebuah desa di Shandong, petani Cheng Yunfu menjual semangkuk mi tarik seharga tiga yuan (sekitar 40 sen) dan menahannya selama ~15 tahun — tak menaikkannya karena tetangganya tak akan mampu. Pada 2021 sebuah video membuatnya terkenal dalam semalam. Ia memakai ketenaran itu membantu seorang ayah mencari anaknya yang diculik, yang akhirnya ditemukan. Mi-nya? Masih tiga yuan.

hi.title: वह आदमी जिसने 15 साल तक 40 सेंट में नूडल्स बेचे | चीन, समझाया
hi.description: शानदोंग के एक गाँव में किसान छंग युनफू तीन युआन (लगभग 40 सेंट) में हाथ से खींचे नूडल्स बेचते थे और करीब 15 साल तक दाम नहीं बढ़ाया — क्योंकि पड़ोसी खरीद नहीं पाते। 2021 में एक वीडियो से वे रातोंरात मशहूर हुए। इस शोहरत से उन्होंने एक पिता को उसके अगवा बेटे को खोजने में मदद की, जो मिल गया। नूडल्स? अब भी तीन युआन।

ar.title: الرجل الذي باع المعكرونة بأربعين سنتاً لمدة 15 عاماً | الصين، ببساطة
ar.description: في قرية بمقاطعة شان​دونغ، باع المزارع تشنغ يون​فو طبق معكرونة مسحوبة باليد بثلاثة يوانات (نحو 40 سنتاً) وثبّت السعر نحو 15 عاماً — لم يرفعه لأن جيرانه لن يقدروا. في 2021 جعله مقطع فيديو مشهوراً بين ليلة وضحاها. استغل الشهرة لمساعدة أب في البحث عن ابنه المخطوف، فعُثر عليه. والمعكرونة؟ ما زالت بثلاثة يوانات.

fr.title: L'homme qui a vendu des nouilles à 40 centimes pendant 15 ans | La Chine, expliquée
fr.description: Dans un village du Shandong, le fermier Cheng Yunfu vendait un bol de nouilles tirées à la main pour trois yuans (environ 40 centimes) et a gardé ce prix une quinzaine d'années — il refusait de l'augmenter car ses voisins n'auraient plus pu payer. En 2021, une vidéo l'a rendu célèbre du jour au lendemain. Il a utilisé cette notoriété pour aider un père à retrouver son fils enlevé, qui l'a été. Les nouilles ? Toujours trois yuans.
